The '''Doan Royal House''' was the royal family of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Doan]]. In [[980 BBY]], they came into conflict with the [[mining caste]], and the conflict escalated after the caste accidentally killed [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Gerran]]. Gerran's wife, Princess [[Serra]], was the daughter of the [[Force healing/Legends|healer]] [[Caleb]] of [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]].<ref name="DOE" />

In 980 BBY, she discovered that her father had been [[Confrontation on Ambria|killed]] by a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], and, assuming this Sith Lord to be [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], the same Sith Lord who had threatened her [[1000 BBY/Legends|twenty years previously]]&mdash;which had caused her father to force her to flee the planet and change her name&mdash;she hired [[Darth Cognus|the Huntress]] to [[Skirmish in Darth Bane's mansion|capture]] him. She then brought him to the [[Stone Prison]] on Doan for interrogation, but, after his escape, she set off a detonator that collapsed the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] and fled to Ambria. Bane, however&mdash;along with the Huntress, who had become his new [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Cognus&mdash;tracked her there. Cognus then killed Serra, thus leaving [[Gerran's father]] the only surviving member of the Royal House.<ref name="DOE" />
